। karttuM tapaH prayAtAstA devAstA dadfSuH SuBAH ॥ tato gate kanyake dve jYAtvA menA tapasvinI । tapaso vArayAmAsa ume tyevAbravIcca sA ॥ tadEva mAtA nAmAsyAScakre pitfsutA SuBA । umetyeva hi kanyAyAH sA jagAma tapovanam ॥” iti vAmane 74 -- 75 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ api ca । “kaTaM girisutA kAlI baBUva jagatAM prasUH । dAkzAyaRI tyaktatanuH kaTamApa haraM patim ॥” mArkaRqeya uvAca । yadAtyajattanuM devI pUrvvaM dAkzAyaRI satI । tadEva manasAgacCanmenakAM himavadgirim । tyaktaprARA tadA devI BUtA himaGataH sutA ॥ SivAvinyastamanasA saptaviMSativatsarAn । ninAya menakA devI paramAmftimicCatI ॥ saptaviMSativarzante jaganmAtA jaganmayI । suprItA BavadatyarTaM prAha pratyakzatAM gatA ॥ SrIdevyuvAca । yat prArTitaM tvayA devi ! mattastat prArTayADunA । tataH sA praTamaM puttraSataM vavre yaSasvinI ॥ paScAttu tanayAmekAM svarUpaguRaSAlinIm । kuladvayAnandakarIM BuvanatrayadurlaBAm ॥ tato BagavatI prAha menakAM munisanniBAm ॥ SrIdevyuvAca । SataM puttrAH saMBavantu BavatyA vIryyasaMyutAH । sutA ca tava devAnAM mAnuzARAYca rakzasAm ॥ hitAya sarvvajagatAM BavizyAmyahameva te । evamuktvA jagadDAtrI tatrEvAntaraDIyata ॥ tataH sA kAlikA devI yoganidrA jaganmayI । pUrvvatyaktasatIrUpA janmArTaM menakAM yayO ॥ samayasyAnurUpeRa menakAjaWare SivA । samudBUya samutpannA sA lakzmIriva sAgarAt ॥ vasantasamaye devI navamyAM mfgayogataH । ardDarAtrO samutpannA gaNgeva SaSimaRqalAt ॥” iti kAlikApurARe 40 aDyAyaH ॥

m: मेरु m. (Uṇ. iv, 101) N. of a fabulous mountain (regarded as the Olympus of Hindū mythology and said to form the central point of Jambu-dvīpa; all the planets revolve round it and it is compared to the cup or seed-vessel of a lotus, the leaves of which are formed by the different Dvīpas q.v.; the river Ganges falls from heaven on its summit, and flows thence to the surrounding worlds in four streams; the regents of the four quarters of the compass occupy the corresponding faces of the mountain, the whole of which consists of gold and gems; its summit is the residence of Brahmā, and a place of meeting for the gods, Ṛṣis, Gandharvas &c., when not regarded as a fabulous mountain, it appears to mean the highland of Tartary north of the Himālaya), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a partic. kind of temple, VarBṛS.
the central or most prominent bead in a rosary, L.

a: मेरुः — 1 N. of a fabulous mountain (round which all the planets are said to revolve; and which forms the centre of the several Dvīpas; cf. द्वीप; it is also said to consist of gold and gems); विभज्य मेरुर्न यदर्थिसात् कृतः N. 1. 16; स्वात्मन्येव समाप्तहेममहिमा मेरुर्न मे रोचते Bh. 3. 150. --2 The central bead in a rosary. --3 The central gem of a necklace. --Comp. --आद्रिकर्णिका the earth. --धामन् m. an epithet of Śiva. --पृष्ठं heaven, the sky. --यंत्रं a figure shaped like a spindle.
